title: Store statement with final state
statement: Let a limit record, program, execution depth, local function $\mathrm{loc}$, memory function $\mu$, budget $T$, address expression $a$, value expression $e$, and postcondition $Q$ be given. Suppose $Q$ holds of the state with local function $\mathrm{loc}$ and memory updated at the natural-number conversion of $a$'s value in $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ to $e$'s value in that state. Suppose also that $a$ and $e$ are safe in $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ and that the value of $a$ is a valid address, meaning it is nonnegative and less than the space bound. If $\mathrm{cost}(a)+\mathrm{cost}(e)+1\le T$, then the store statement can execute from $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ with cost at most $T$ and end in a state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: Q holds of the state whose memory is updated at the natural-number conversion of a's value in (loc, μ) to e's value there.
a and e are safe in (loc, μ), and a's value is a valid address.
